kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أسترئف (form X)
# أَسْتَرْئِفُ (ʔastarʔifu) /ʔas.tar.ʔi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# أَسْتَرْئِفَ (ʔastarʔifa) /ʔas.tar.ʔi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# أَسْتَرْئِفْ (ʔastarʔif) /ʔas.tar.ʔif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
